notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.tactics_ogre). Keep every command of the original, in order. A message starts with its speaker's name between {8B} and {8C} (shown at once), then a line end; {8E}{8A} waits for A and starts the next page, {8D}{8A} ends the message. {8705} is Rictor's name, written out from the entry rictor. Line ends after text (\n) may move; a page holds the lines of its window (three, or two in some messages, the name's line included), of at most 176 pixels. Speech has no quotation marks. No vowel marks: the font has none.
